senses.definition: A curve on a graph that initially falls, then rises to a point higher than its starting point.
A kind of fountain pen with a broad, stubby nib, originally stamped with a "J".
senses.example: The calligraphy was, like the paper, unusual, bold, decided, and, I should have guessed, produced by a J pen.

senses.definition: A paddling technique used by the sternman of a canoe that starts with a stroke perpendicular to the boat and ends with a hook behind the back of the boat. This forms a letter "J" when paddling on the right side of the boat. The technique is used to overcome the tendency of the boat to turn when paddling on one side and
A vertical omnidirectional transmitting antenna used in the shortwave frequency bands.
